title: fix(os): the wave 6 boot heal — the compact ids ride the webcrypto well
body: The os booted blank in every browser since the chat lineage wave: chatstate's birth ids pull ids.ts, and ids.ts imported node:crypto.randomBytes — vite externalizes it for the browser and the module graph dies silently at import, so App.tsx never evaluated and the root stayed empty (the previous session verified only the http 200, never the render). The heal swaps the compact token well to globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues — webcrypto, answering in every browser and every node since 19 — and the browser verification now walks the whole golden path: the lock screen renders with the clock riding the left column, the unlock opens the windows sign-in face, the account creation lands on the desktop panel, the settings app renders the personalization categories, and the navbar position re-docks live between floating and the left rail.
commitTitle: fix(os): the wave 6 boot heal lands — the compact ids ride the webcrypto well instead of node:crypto
commitMessage: the os booted blank since the chat lineage wave: ids.ts imported node:crypto.randomBytes and the browser graph died silently at import — App never evaluated, the root stayed empty, and only the http status had ever been verified. the compact tokens now draw from globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues (webcrypto, every browser, every node since 19) and the golden path verifies live in the browser: lock screen with the clock on the left, windows sign-in face, account creation into the desktop, the settings personalization and the navbar re-docking between floating and the left rail.
